steps.title: Read the company file
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "Company · Identity", "Company · Activity", "Company · Expected volumes" and "Company · Card acceptance": identity, activity, expected volumes, card acceptance.

steps.title: Check the company documents
steps.prompt: Run "Check documents": the Kbis extract (under 3 months), the articles of association and the beneficial owners declaration are checked; the result card lists each one, valid or what is wrong.

steps.title: Read the document results
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "Documents · Complete", "Documents · Kbis extract", "Documents · Articles of association" and "Documents · Beneficial owners declaration".

steps.title: Check the company register (INPI)
steps.prompt: Run "Check the company register": INPI's register of companies (RNE) and register of beneficial owners, compared line by line with our documents and customer file. It records each company paper as passed or failed, now.

steps.title: Read the INPI result
steps.prompt: Read all 3 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "Register · Result" and "Register · Differences" (the INPI check and the differences with our file), and "Documents · Complete" again for the next decision.

steps.title: Company documents complete?
steps.prompt: Complete when "Documents · Complete" says "✓ Yes" and "Register · Result" starts with "✓ Matches". Missing or outdated otherwise.

steps.title: Request company documents
steps.prompt: Run "Request company documents": the request asks for what is missing or outdated; the result card shows it with its due date.

steps.title: Check the beneficial owners
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "Owners · More than 25%", "Owners · Directors", "Owners · 25% or less" and "Owners · Structure": who holds more than 25% (directly or through holdings), who holds less, the directors, and the structure.

steps.title: Beneficial owners identified?
steps.prompt: Yes when "Owners · More than 25%" names each owner with a country (or, with nobody above 25%, the legal representative by default) and "Owners · Directors" names a director (both ✓). No when one shows ✗: ask the company for its register of beneficial owners.

steps.title: Verify the ID documents
steps.prompt: Run "Verify document": Onfido checks every ID of the company's people still waiting, live, and matches each selfie to its ID; one result card per ID.

steps.title: Read the ID check results
steps.prompt: Read all 3 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "ID checks · Result", "ID checks · Documents" and "ID checks · Face match": each ID with its result and confidence, each selfie matched to its ID, and the overall result.

steps.title: ID documents valid?
steps.prompt: Valid when "ID checks · Result" starts with "✓ Passed". Not valid when it shows ✗ Failed or ⚠ Needs a closer look: ask for a new ID.

steps.title: Request a new ID document
steps.prompt: Run "Request ID document": the person gets a request in the app to upload a valid ID; the result card shows the request and its due date.

steps.title: Screen the company and its people
steps.prompt: Run "Screen against sanctions lists": the result card lists each name checked and any match.

steps.title: Read the screening result
steps.prompt: Read the field "Screening · Result" of this KYC case: each hit on the company or its people (✗ open or confirmed, ○ cleared before), or no hit.

steps.title: Open screening hit?
steps.prompt: Open hit when "Screening · Result" lists a hit marked ✗ and "open". Clear otherwise: "✓ No hit", or only hits cleared before (○).

steps.title: Park the case for screening
steps.prompt: Run "Park for screening": the case leaves the onboarding queue until the screening team decides on the hit; the result card lists the open hits.

steps.title: Read the card acceptance request
steps.prompt: Read the field "Company · Card acceptance" of this KYC case: not requested, granted already, or requested with the sales profile (what is sold, how far ahead it is paid, chargebacks).

steps.title: Card acceptance requested?
steps.prompt: Requested when "Company · Card acceptance" starts with "⚠ Requested, to decide". Not requested otherwise ("✓ Not requested" or "✓ Granted already").

steps.title: Card acceptance
steps.prompt: Look at the sales profile in "Company · Card acceptance": what would the bank pay back if the company stopped delivering? Mostly online or delivered after 14 days is riskier: approve with a reserve.

steps.title: Approve card acceptance
steps.prompt: Run "Approve card acceptance".

steps.title: Set a reserve
steps.prompt: Run "Set a reserve": 5 to 20% of sales held for 90 to 180 days.

steps.title: Read the risk inputs
steps.prompt: Read all 6 of these fields of this KYC case (every one is needed): "Risk · Suggested rating", "Risk · Screening hits", "Risk · PEP", "Risk · Residence", "Risk · Structure" and "Risk · Card sales".

steps.title: Risk rating?
steps.prompt: Low when every "Risk ·" line shows ✓: no open hit, no PEP, owners in the EU, at most 2 holding levels, card sales within limits. "Risk · Suggested rating" applies these rules; you decide.

steps.title: Ask for a senior sign-off
steps.prompt: Run "Send for senior sign-off": the case waits for a senior, out of the onboarding queue.

steps.title: Senior review
steps.prompt: You take over from the operator: read the "Risk ·" lines above, then write in one or two sentences why the bank accepts or refuses this risk.

steps.title: Onboard this company?
steps.prompt: Your decision, as the senior operator.

steps.title: Approve KYC
steps.prompt: Run "Approve KYC": it refuses when a document, an ID or a screening hit is still open.

steps.title: Reject KYC
steps.prompt: Run "Reject KYC": the reason is pre-filled from the failed checks.
